title: 1876 켄터키 고기비
version: 2026-11-04 터진 영상 방식 파일럿 (첫 화면=현상, 1.6초 컷, 실물 신문, 답 공개, 꼬리 없음)

images.prompt: Ground-level close-up of a dry dirt farmyard in 1876 rural Kentucky at midday: a fist-sized chunk of raw red meat falling straight toward the viewer out of a perfectly clear, bright blue, cloudless sky, more small red pieces falling behind it with motion streaks, a wooden split-rail fence in the background.

A farm woman in an 1870s rural Kentucky dress and apron at a big iron soap kettle steaming over a small fire in her front yard at midday. She has stopped stirring and looks straight up at the sky with wide eyes and an open mouth in shock. Small red pieces fall around her like snowflakes under a clear blue cloudless sky.

Wide view of a small 1870s Kentucky farmyard with a log farmhouse and a split-rail fence at midday under a perfectly clear bright blue sky. In the foreground, many large chunks of raw red meat fall densely through the air like a heavy snowfall, some landing on the fence rails and piling up on the dirt.

High aerial view looking straight down on farmland: one sharply bounded rectangular patch of grass densely covered with small red pieces, while all the grass around it is perfectly clean and green, a split-rail fence and a tiny log farmhouse at the edge, bright daylight.

Two bearded farmers in 1870s work clothes and wide-brimmed hats crouching in a grassy farmyard. One holds up a small piece of red meat between his fingers, about to put it in his mouth, while the other watches with a doubtful frown. Small red pieces are scattered on the grass. Bright midday, clear sky.

Tight close-up portrait of ONE bearded 1870s farmer in a wide-brimmed brown hat and olive work jacket, alone in the frame, chewing a small piece of red meat with a thoughtful, doubtful face and one eyebrow raised, bright midday daylight, clear blue sky and farm fence blurred behind him.
Extreme close-up of a 19th-century brass microscope on a wooden laboratory desk, glass specimen dishes with small reddish tissue samples lined up beside it, warm oil-lamp light.

Full-frame view through a microscope eyepiece: a huge circular field of view filling almost the whole picture, showing magnified pinkish animal tissue, spongy lung tissue, striped muscle fibers and smooth pale cartilage side by side, the area outside the circle is pure dark navy, scientific illustration feel.
Dramatic low angle looking up from a farmyard into a bright clear blue sky: a flock of large black vultures circling high overhead with wings spread wide, sunlight.

Comic close-up of a big black vulture flying in a clear bright blue sky, its hooked beak wide open, throwing up a stream of small red meat pieces from its beak that tumble down toward the ground, funny and gross webtoon style, not bloody.
Close-up of the same bearded 1870s farmer in a wide-brimmed hat frozen in disgust, eyes wide, one hand clapped over his mouth, cheeks puffed as if about to be sick, bright daylight, clear blue sky.

A 19th-century scientist with round spectacles and a mustache in a dark coat, in a bright laboratory, proudly holding up a glass jar of frog spawn (clear jelly eggs with black dots) toward the viewer with a confident smile, comic webtoon style.
Comic macro close-up of a piece of raw red meat lying on grass with a few small wriggling earthworms on it, funny and gross webtoon style, bright daylight, not bloody.

scenes.say: 구름 한 점 없는 한낮, 하늘에서 고기가 떨어졌습니다.
비누를 끓이던 농가 부인이, 하늘을 올려다봤죠.
그런데 딱, 이 땅 한 구역에만요.
루이빌의 한 과학자는, 바람에 날려 온 개구리 알이라 했고,
날면서, 먹은 걸 한꺼번에 게워 냈다는 거죠.

youtube.title: 맑은 하늘에서 고기가 떨어졌다, 이웃 둘은 맛까지 봤다
youtube.summary: 1876년 3월 미국 켄터키의 한 농가. 구름 한 점 없는 한낮, 작은 땅 한 구역에만 고기 조각이 몇 분 동안 떨어졌습니다. 당시 신문들은 개구리 알, 벌레라고 했지만 현미경 속 조각은 폐·근육·연골이었습니다.
youtube.pinned: 당신이라면, 그 고기 맛봤을까요? 맛본다 / 절대 안 먹는다로 답해 주세요.

sources: 출처: New York Herald(1876.3.15), White Pine News(1876.3.18), New Orleans Republican(1876.3.22) — 미국 의회도서관 Chronicling America / 뉴욕타임스(1876.3.10), Scientific American(1876), L. D. Kastenbine, Louisville Medical News(1876), Scientific American 블로그(2014)
